faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Sahi size kaisay chunun?
items.answer: Har product page par size guide mojood hai — apnay bust/waist/hip inches ke hisaab se choose karein. Confused hain? /fit-finder try karein ya WhatsApp par contact karein.

items.question: Shipping mein kitna time lagta hai?
items.answer: Karachi/Lahore/Islamabad: 2-3 din. Baaki Pakistan: 3-5 kaam ke din. Order confirm hone ke baad tracking number SMS/email par milta hai.

items.question: Cash on Delivery available hai?
items.answer: Jee haan — poore Pakistan mein COD available hai. Order place karte waqt "Cash on Delivery" select karein.

items.question: Shipping kitni hai? Free kab hoti hai?
items.answer: Flat rate PKR 350. PKR 4,999 se upar ke order par shipping bilkul FREE.

items.question: Discreet packaging hoti hai?
items.answer: Bilkul. Har order plain, unbranded packaging mein aata hai — bahar kuch nahi likha hota. Aap ki privacy hamari zimmedari hai.

items.question: Return / exchange kaisay karoon?
items.answer: 14 din ke andar unused / unworn product exchange kar sakte hain. Hygiene ki wajah se innerwear ki wapsi sirf defective items par hoti hai. Contact karein: /track ya WhatsApp.

items.question: Fabric quality kya hai?
items.answer: Har product 3-tier quality system se pass hota hai — cotton, modal, aur cooling mesh premium sources se. Fabric details har product page par listed hain.

items.question: Payment methods kya kya available hain?
items.answer: Abhi Cash on Delivery (COD) available hai. JazzCash, EasyPaisa, Bank Transfer aur online cards jaldi add ho rahay hain.

items.question: Order kaisay track karoon?
items.answer: Order confirm hone par aap ko unique order number milta hai (VL-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX). /track page par jaa kar order number + phone se live status dekhein.

items.question: Kya aap international ship karte hain?
items.answer: Abhi sirf Pakistan ke andar deliver karte hain. Middle East aur international shipping jaldi shuru hogi.
